name: asset-curator
description: Find usable assets or create them from code, with saved license/browser/acquisition policy, optional classifier and preserved provenance.

nace_key.label: Optional direct Nace / Drex v1.1 key

custom_url.label: Optional custom classifier URL
custom_url.description: OpenAI-compatible chat/completions endpoint for the custom classifier (HTTPS, or localhost). Receives the custom classifier key, so only you set it here; the agent cannot change it.

projects_folder.label: Project workspace (project or review mode)
projects_folder.description: Existing absolute workspace. Project mode can read/change files only here, with assets defaulting to asset-curator/. Review mode promotes approved assets there. User-set only; restart after changes.

access_mode.label: Permissions: hermes, or separate full / project / review / no
access_mode.description: Choose hermes to use host tool approvals, not an inherited filesystem sandbox. Separate project (recommended) limits file changes to one workspace and outputs to asset-curator/. review stages an Asset Review Queue for host-confirmed promotion. no suggests only; downloads/use require approval. full removes plugin path limits, not OS or host safeguards. Until chosen, no mode applies. User-set only; restart after changes.
